name: tribute-singer-does-not-offer-a-melody-it-cannot-pay-for
notes: Tribute Singer with an empty hand after paying for it: the Modulating Cadence among the top five (cost 4, 1 after the discount) cannot be paid for, so it is not offered; all five cards go to the bottom. It used to be offered and, once chosen, moved into the hand for free before the refused activation.

engineBug.summary: FIXED. Effects that let you activate a card from outside your hand (Tribute Singer, Slime Calling, Clockwork Musicbox) offered every candidate and moved the chosen card into the hand BEFORE checking that it could be activated, so a card whose cost could not be paid ended up in the hand for free (and Slime Calling's one-shot discount lingered). Fix: candidates are offered only when ActivationRefusedBeforeStart() allows them (with the effect's discount applied while asking), and the chosen card is re-validated before it moves.
